messages:
Maria: Quick weekly check-in on Acme Corp — new model v2 rollout went live Wed. Early signals: traffic split ~30% v2 / 70% v1, but after the in-app prompt change adoption jumped to ~45% in last 24h.
Sam: Nice, thanks. What are we seeing for fallback rates from v2 -> v1?
Priya: Fallbacks = 7.2% overall (was ~3.1% before rollout). Majority are on long-context sessions (>2048 tokens) where we see KV cache misses + a tokenization mismatch on a few prompt templates.
Diego: Any obvious latency regressions?
Priya: p50 latency: v1 220ms -> v2 310ms (short requests). p95: v1 1.2s -> v2 1.9s. Spike correlates with batching timeout and some larger batches for mixed-length traffic.
Maria: Spend note: Acme weekly billed spend up ~18% WoW (token + GPU ramp). They flagged responsiveness in CS sync. Not a renewal blocker yet but a concern.
Sam: Is this something we can fix quickly or should we space changes?
Priya: Short-term mitigations I recommend:
```
- routing rule: prefer v1 when input_tokens > 2048
- enable KV prefix caching on v2 for repeated prompts
- reduce batch timeout to 15ms for v2 workers
```
These should cut fallback drivers and lower p95.
Diego: Can we canary the traffic change? propose: reduce v2 to 20% for business-critical routes, keep 50% for non-customer/internal tests.
Maria: Sounds good. Sam, can you prep the customer note? They want clarity on "why responses got slower".
Sam: Yep — I'll draft a one-pager that explains model distribution, fallbacks, and our remediation plan.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: model:v2 deployed 2026-02-12T04:15Z — health: degraded (3 restarts in last 24h) — routing temporarily sticky.
Priya: Good catch — restart logs show a retry storm during a batch timeout bump; I'll pull traces and correlate with fallbacks.
Maria: Action items: Priya to open config change + export fallback traces + exemplar prompts; Diego to apply canary routing; Sam to schedule customer call and prep one-pager.
Sam: I'll schedule the call for tomorrow EPD sync and share materials beforehand.
Priya: I'll post the trace dump and short summary here before the call.
Maria: Thanks team. Re-check in next Tue sync unless something urgent pops up. :thumbsup:
